headlines.title: Abdul El-Sayed addresses past criticism of Obama: 'I was younger’ and ‘angry’
headlines.description: In an exclusive interview with Meet the Press, Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed (D) discusses the biggest hurdles he's facing on the campaign trail and his top priorities if he wins.

headlines.title: Can you trust the vote?
headlines.description: Pennsylvania’s top election official explains how claims of voter fraud make it harder to make the vote secure

headlines.title: Saudi airport struck again a day after deadly attack
headlines.description: The Saudi-led coalition said a projectile struck a terminal at Riyadh’s airport Sunday, a day after a missile attack killed 13 people and injured 309.

headlines.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
headlines.description: An unidentified projectile struck Saudi Arabia’s main international airport Sunday, injuring people a day after a deadly missile attack at the same site raised questions about whether the U.S. would join another conflict in the region.

headlines.title: How the Philadelphia Eagles pulled off the wildest loss of the NFL season
headlines.description: The Eagles have now lost back-to-back games in which they led during the final two minutes.

headlines.title: To counteract a spooky economy, America prepares to spend on Halloween candy
headlines.description: This Halloween, rising prices for groceries and gas are pushing many consumers to cut back. But they’re not giving up Halloween candy.

headlines.title: Pope Leo says he will undergo surgery to remove a nodule on his lung
headlines.description: The American pope, 71, said Sunday recent medical checks led to the detection of the early-stage nodule. The procedure will take place this week, the Vatican said.

headlines.title: In new Elon Musk documentary, his lieutenants are the most damning voices
headlines.description: ‘Musk,’ the new film from Alex Gibney, features interviews with more than the usual critics of the Tesla and SpaceX CEO.

headlines.title: Food pantries overwhelmed by Trump cuts
headlines.description: Those on the front lines of feeding their neighbors in rural West Virginia say they face unprecedented challenges brought on by Washington.

headlines.title: Affording America: How a single mother in Chicago turned to gig work to survive
headlines.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family. For over a year she's been making extra money as a gig worker, doing DoorDash food deliveries around Chicago, often with her kids sitting in the back seat of the car.

headlines.title: We just witnessed the most mind-boggling ending of the NFL season
headlines.description: The Washington Commanders were on their way to beating the New York Giants in overtime. Then they ran out the clock on themselves and settled for a tie.

headlines.title: Kelly Clarkson says a Brooklyn store snubbed her. The shop says the item she wanted wasn’t for sale.
headlines.description: Clarkson blasted Art of Play, alleging it treated her like she “couldn’t afford” its merchandise. The store says the resulting backlash was “surreal.”
